notes.title: AEROMACHINA: Test-Flight – Hotfix (ver. 0.1.0.1)
notes.content:
Hi everybody, and thank you for the day one love! We hope you've been enjoying your time with Bogey's Test-Flight thus far. 

Your feedback has been great to see - and we've been working hard today to sort out the biggest issues we've seen reported thus far.


Hotfix (ver. 0.1.1)


- Some issues regarding unlock permanence on death should be resolved

- The mysterious ghost crates in Storage Room A have been exorcised

- A couple of false dialogue triggers have been fixed

- The endgame sidequest now has improved breadcrumbing

- Performance in Caret's death spinner room has been improved

- Fixed a rare issue where the Vulcan Gun would not function correctly

- Can no longer out of bounds in the Armoury
